name: Kumar Roshan
summary:
Results-driven Power BI Developer & Data Analyst with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise-grade BI
solutions across logistics, shipping, and e-commerce domains. Expert in Advanced DAX, Power Query (M), Semantic Data

management. Seeking a challenging Power BI / BI Developer role to deliver scalable, high-impact analytics solutions.
